responsibility: Defines the instruction scheduling automata for the PowerPC 476 embedded core. It models the 476’s multi-issue core, branch, load/simple-integer, complex-integer, and optional floating-point pipes and gives reservation/latency data for rs6000 instruction classes, allowing GCC’s RTL scheduler to tune instruction ordering and hazards for -mcpu=476 and its floating-point variant.
same_name_distinction: Unlike 476.h and 476.opt, this is the machine-description member of the 476 group: it models the PPC476 core’s issue pipelines, reservations, and latencies for instruction scheduling rather than exposing options or target-hook macro overrides.
